data.title: 在原七海 · 书架上的一本书
data.description: 七海在书架前找到想看的书，抽出来时小心扶住了旁边一排。她看了看封面，决定借回去慢慢读。
data.action: taking a book from a bookshelf
data.promptProse: In a tranquil, sunlit library aisle, Nanami gently slides a hardcover volume from a towering mahogany bookshelf, her other hand delicately steadying the neighboring books. Golden afternoon rays stream through tall arched windows, casting slanted geometric shadows and illuminating floating dust motes between rows of neatly arranged classic volumes.
